name: Summit AZ - SEO Audit Baseline 2026-09-10
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-09-10

# Summary
Post-relaunch audit and baseline from a server-side crawl of all 189 sitemap URLs, Rank Math data, GSC (Aug 12 to Sep 8 vs prior 28 days), Search Atlas Site Explorer and PageSpeed. The audit was read-only; fixes followed Sep 10 to 11 with Kim's approval, and the file was updated with a "current state after fixes" table. An HTML dashboard of the same baseline (`Summit-AZ-SEO-Dashboard-2026-09-10.html`) sits in the folder.

# Bottom line
1. The technical base is clean (all 200, self canonicals, no broken links, schema everywhere).
2. Almost no non-branded traffic: 37 clicks in 28 days, all identified clicks branded.
3. The biggest ceiling is authority: Domain Authority 6 with about 23 real referring domains.

# Baseline numbers
- 189 indexable URLs (156 pages, 28 posts); 15 noindexed. GSC 28 days: 37 clicks, 10,011 impressions (down 13%), position about 23. 90 days: 121 clicks, 49,685 impressions.
- Mobile PageSpeed on /drain-cleaning/: 69 (LCP 3.0 s, TBT 570 ms, CLS 0.05). No CrUX field data. Median content 1,414 words. 164 pages with exactly one FAQPage block.

# Before and after fixes (Sep 10 to Sep 11)
- Images missing alt 336 to 0; orphan pages 4 to 0; no focus keyword 28 to 5 (intentional); missing metas 4 to 0; multiple H1s 3 to 1 (homepage, report only); titles over 70 characters 32 to 15; 24/7 claims 1 to 0.

# Findings list (high and medium)
- /plumbing-repair/ had no internal links (crawled not indexed). The Tempe emergency page was invisible while the Tempe hub took its searches. /thank-you-page/ was indexable again (noindex did not carry over from Yoast). /drain-cleaning-special/ sent conflicting robots tags. One "around-the-clock" claim on the Gilbert emergency page.
- Rank Math focus keywords missing or not city-specific on several pages; 188 of the missing alts were the header logo; weakly linked pages (/slab-leaks/, /water-filtration-systems/, Mesa FAQ page); the rank tracker was mostly brand and junk terms; mobile speed fair.

# Data files folded in
- `Summit-AZ-SEO-Baseline-Pages-2026-09-10.csv` (before) and `Summit-AZ-SEO-Baseline-Pages-2026-09-11.csv` (after): one row per URL with title, meta length, H1s, focus keyword, words, images, alts, FAQ schema, inbound links and flags.
